Title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
FAQ: How do I set up two-factor authentication?

Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. To enable 2FA, go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and click Enable. We support authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) and SMS verification. Authenticator apps are recommended over SMS for stronger security. After enabling 2FA, you will be prompted for a verification code at each login.
--- End Document 1 ---

final_answer: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is a security system that requires multiple forms of authentication from independent categories of credentials to verify the identity of users. These categories can include something you know (password), something you have (security token), something you are (biometrics), or something you do (behavioral analysis). By requiring two or more credentials, MFA significantly reduces the risk of unauthorized access, as an attacker would need to compromise multiple factors to gain access. This adds a layer of security to your account, making it more difficult for hackers to breach. [Source: Multi-Factor Authentication: A Comprehensive Guide]
